label: Bible Study
prompt: I will seek that which was _____, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.
verse: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.
note: God as the good shepherd, seeking the lost — Jesus picks up the same picture in the Gospels.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For there is hope of a _____, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
verse: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
note: Even a cut-down tree may sprout again — Job's picture of hope that won't stay stumped.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the _____, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.
verse: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.
note: From one rib, a whole woman — and Adam's first recorded words are a delighted 'bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: Moreover as for me, God forbid that I should sin against the LORD in _____ to pray for you: but I will teach you the good and the right way:
verse: Moreover as for me, God forbid that I should sin against the LORD in ceasing to pray for you: but I will teach you the good and the right way:
note: Samuel, rejected as judge when Israel demanded a king, still counts it a sin to stop praying for them.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that _____ Israel?
verse: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel?
note: Ahab greeted Elijah as 'he that troubleth Israel'; Elijah shot back that Ahab was the real troubler (18:18).
